stem: A TV promotion shows a halo of 60 soundbars. Which conclusion does this number support on its own?

options.text: The TV deal caused 60 extra soundbar sales once the season is taken out
Soundbars sold 60 more units in the deal weeks than their baselines
The extra soundbar margin paid for the discount given on the TVs
60 shoppers bought a soundbar in the same order as a promoted TV
